# SocialCRM

> A lead management CRM for small businesses. Leads from Facebook Lead Ads, Instagram ads and WhatsApp land in one list, each with a source, a status and a rep.

Website: https://getsocialcrm.com

## Language

The SocialCRM app, including sign-up, is currently in Hebrew. Other interface languages are limited to an authorized multilingual pilot.

## What it does

- Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads: connect a Facebook business page and leads from Lead Ad forms enter the system automatically, with a source and a status.
- Instagram direct messages: these do not come in automatically. They are added by hand.
- WhatsApp: connect a WhatsApp Business account. Conversations connect to the lead, and replies are sent from the system with delivery and read status.
- Lead statuses: New, In progress, Interested, Closed and Lost.
- Reps: assign leads to reps.
- Excel: import existing leads from Excel, and export to Excel or PDF.
- AI, on the Pro plan: a summary of each lead, key points, a recommended next step and draft follow-up messages. A draft is sent only when a person clicks send.

## Pricing

Card required. The first 7 days are free. After that, the subscription renews automatically at ₪89/month unless cancelled before the first charge. Prices are in Israeli shekels (ILS). To verify the card, the card company may place a temporary hold of ₪1. It is not a charge.
